mapper.select: SELECT h.*, dst.name AS district, dvs.name AS division FROM hotels h JOIN districts dst ON dst.id = h.districts_id JOIN divisions dvs ON dvs.id = dst.divisions_id ORDER BY dvs.id DESC
SELECT h.*, dst.name AS district, dvs.name AS division FROM hotels h JOIN districts dst ON dst.id = h.districts_id JOIN divisions dvs ON dvs.id = dst.divisions_id WHERE h.id = #{id}
